caption:
94% of senior executives say they're open to a new role. That number was reported this month and picked up across four Indian business outlets in two days.

Read it plainly: the senior market is fluid, and the October–December stretch is when those conversations accelerate.

Which means more rooms. More first meetings. More twenty-minute windows where the decision gets made before your track record is ever discussed.

In those twenty minutes, four things carry you:

Bearing — how you enter and how you sit.
Tone — steady, unhurried, no upward lift at the end of a sentence.
Silence — held on purpose, not filled out of nerves.
The number — stated once, without flinching or hedging.

Thirty-five years of command taught Colonel Suhag that authority is read long before it is proven. Competence gets you into the room. Presence decides whether you're the one pulled up.

The rooms are opening. Be ready for the twenty minutes.
